name: Threat intelligence ingest
description: End-to-end ingest of external cyber threat intelligence: pull an upstream feed (STIX 2.1 / TAXII or OCSF Threat Intelligence), normalise indicators into the OCSF event surface, and propagate the result to detection (Sigma rule activation) and blocking (network/EDR blocklist) controls. The playbook is the portable response per OASIS CACAO v2; runtime is the operator's choice (n8n, Temporal, LangGraph).

__feed_url__.description: TAXII collection URL or STIX 2.1 bundle endpoint to poll. Credentials are injected at compile-target runtime (directive 6); never inline here.

__feed_id__.description: Stable identifier of the upstream feed (e.g. AbuseIPDB, MISP community, ENISA EU-CSIRTs network feed).

__confidence_threshold__.description: Minimum confidence score (0-100) at which an indicator is propagated to blocking controls; lower-confidence indicators are kept for detection only.

__indicator_count__.description: Number of indicators normalised from the upstream bundle.

action--20000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: pull upstream feed
action--20000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Poll the configured TAXII collection or STIX 2.1 endpoint and capture the raw bundle. The endpoint is operator-supplied; we do not embed feed URLs in the content model.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: normalise STIX to OCSF
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Map STIX 2.1 SDOs (Indicator, Malware, Threat-Actor) to the OCSF Threat Intelligence Inference (5005) event class. Persist normalised records keyed by indicator value; deduplicate against any record seen within the last 24 hours.

if-condition--40000000-0000-4000-8000-00.name: above confidence threshold?
if-condition--40000000-0000-4000-8000-00.description: Branch on whether the normalised indicator clears the operator-set confidence threshold. High-confidence indicators are pushed to blocking controls; the rest activate detection rules only.

action--50000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: propagate to blocklist
action--50000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Push high-confidence indicators (IPs, domains, file hashes) to the operator's enforcement plane: perimeter firewall, DNS sinkhole, EDR allow/deny list. Records the propagation event so MTTR-to-block can be measured.

action--60000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: activate detection rule
action--60000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Activate or refresh the corresponding Sigma rule(s) in the operator's SIEM so subsequent telemetry matching the indicator generates an alert. Sigma rule IDs are pinned upstream (SigmaHQ); the framework does not re-author rule bodies.

sources: OCSF v1.3 — Findings and Threat Intelligence categories
SigmaHQ rule catalog (rule IDs only; rule bodies remain upstream)
DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Article 19(2) — voluntary cyber-threat notification
ENISA — EU CSIRTs network operational guidance
